name: Doré shipment to the refinery
summary: Every week or two the mill ships the doré bars that have built up in the gold room vault to the refinery that will turn them into fine gold. The mill superintendent books an armoured carrier, the gold room operators take the bars out of the vault under the two-person rule, re-weigh them and pack them into sealed boxes, and the superintendent writes the manifest and the shipment advice that tells the refinery and head office what is coming. A security officer checks the carrier's crew at the gate, both sides count boxes and seal numbers and sign the custody receipt, and the shipment is done when the refinery confirms receipt weights that match. The carrier's route schedule, the insured value limit per trip and winter conditions on the gravel access road set the timing, and a weight or seal mismatch at the refinery starts an investigation.

baseline.org_archetype: A 300-person single-mine Ontario gold producer pouring about 7,500 oz a month as doré in a mill gold room 1.5 to 2 hours by road from Wawa, shipping to a Canadian refinery by armoured carrier.
baseline.notes: Modelled on a single-mine northern Ontario gold producer (Eagle River mine and mill near Wawa) as described in the organisation file; site practice from the Eagle River technical reports where they say it.

unit_of_work: one doré shipment (typically four to eight bars in sealed boxes)
trigger: Doré in the gold room vault reaches the planned shipment size or the date set with the carrier.
end_state: The refinery confirms receipt of the sealed boxes with gross weights that agree with the manifest, and the shipment is recorded as doré in transit to refining.

volume.seasonality: Steady through the year; winter storms on the access road occasionally move a pickup by a day or two.

evidence.note: About 7,500 oz a month (91,229 oz sold in 2020, wdomda2021) poured from daily table concentrate and bi-weekly sock clean-ups (srk2022). Two to four shipments a month keeps each shipment near 2,000-4,000 oz, a common insured-value limit for one armoured pickup; author's estimate.

Organisation file role (1 people). Plans each shipment, books the carrier, signs the manifest and checks the refinery receipt. Loaded cost from the organisation file: base wage times 1.30 for staff roles and 1.35 for hourly site roles.

Organisation file role (2 people). Two operators handle bars together under the two-person rule; minutes are recorded for one operator. Loaded cost from the organisation file: base wage times 1.30 for staff roles and 1.35 for hourly site roles.

Organisation file role (4 people). Witnesses the vault opening and checks the carrier crew at the gate. Loaded cost from the organisation file: base wage times 1.30 for staff roles and 1.35 for hourly site roles.

Organisation file role (1 people). Confirms declared value against insurance and carrier limits and tells the bullion bank what is coming. Loaded cost from the organisation file: base wage times 1.30 for staff roles and 1.35 for hourly site roles.

Organisation file role (1 people). Records the inventory transfer to doré in transit. Not listed for this process in the organisation file. Loaded cost from the organisation file: base wage times 1.30 for staff roles and 1.35 for hourly site roles.

Shared drives and document library (procedures, permits, drawings)

resources.name: Refinery (sock burner oven and propane furnace in a secure room)

steps.name: Decide shipment size and date
steps.description: The mill superintendent checks the vault log and the gold room record for bars poured since the last shipment, compares the estimated ounces and value with the per-trip insured limit, and picks a pickup date that fits the carrier's route days and the rotation.

error.defect_description: Planned value above the insured limit for one trip.

evidence.note: Doré is stored in a concrete vault with a safe in the restricted-entry refinery (srk2022). Decision rule and times: Author's estimate from common practice for doré shipments from remote Canadian gold mines, 2019-2022.

steps.name: Book armoured carrier pickup
steps.description: The superintendent emails the carrier's dispatch with the pickup site, requested date, number of boxes, gross weight and declared value, and asks for crew names and the vehicle number.

error.defect_description: Wrong declared value or weight on the request.

evidence.note: Gold delivery to the refiners is contracted to Brinks at a comparable Ontario mine (macassa2019). Times: Author's estimate from common practice for doré shipments from remote Canadian gold mines, 2019-2022.

steps.name: Carrier confirms pickup window
steps.description: The carrier fits the pickup into its northern Ontario route and replies with the date, time window, crew names and vehicle number, or offers another day.

error.defect_description: None introduced; errors from earlier steps pass through.

evidence.note: Author's estimate from common practice for doré shipments from remote Canadian gold mines, 2019-2022.

steps.name: Confirm value and insurance cover
steps.description: The treasury and tax manager checks the declared value at the current gold price against the carrier's liability and the company's cargo insurance limit, confirms or asks for the shipment to be split, and tells the bullion bank how many ounces to expect.

error.defect_description: None introduced; errors from earlier steps pass through.

control.basis: Corporate insurance policy and carrier contract: declared value per shipment within cover limits

evidence.note: Author's estimate from common practice for doré shipments from remote Canadian gold mines, 2019-2022.

steps.name: Open vault and re-weigh bars
steps.description: On the morning of the pickup two gold room operators open the vault, take out each bar, re-weigh it on the gold room scale and check the bar number, stamped weight and sample record against the gold room record.

error.defect_description: Re-weigh not compared or a bar number misread.

control.basis: Gold room security procedure: two-person rule, camera coverage and logged access for every vault opening

evidence.note: Restricted-entry refinery with CCTV and a concrete vault with a safe (srk2022). Times: Author's estimate from common practice for doré shipments from remote Canadian gold mines, 2019-2022.

steps.name: Witness vault opening and log access
steps.description: A security officer stands in the gold room while the vault is open, logs the names and times in the access log, watches the camera view and signs the bar check sheet as witness.

error.defect_description: None introduced; errors from earlier steps pass through.

control.basis: Gold room security procedure: two-person rule, camera coverage and logged access for every vault opening

evidence.note: Refinery is a restricted-entry facility with closed-circuit television (srk2022). Times: Author's estimate from common practice for doré shipments from remote Canadian gold mines, 2019-2022.

steps.name: Pack bars and seal boxes
steps.description: The operators pack the bars into the carrier's numbered shipping boxes with padding, close each box with numbered tamper-evident seals, weigh each sealed box and write the seal numbers and gross weights on the packing sheet.

error.defect_description: Seal number written wrong on the packing sheet.

control.basis: Gold room security procedure: two-person rule, camera coverage and logged access for every vault opening

evidence.note: Author's estimate from common practice for doré shipments from remote Canadian gold mines, 2019-2022.

steps.name: Prepare manifest and shipment advice
steps.description: The superintendent fills in the carrier manifest with box and seal numbers and gross weights, and writes the shipment advice for the refinery and head office with bar numbers, weights, mine gold and silver assays and estimated fine ounces.

error.defect_description: Assay or weight typed wrong in the advice.

evidence.note: Author's estimate from common practice for doré shipments from remote Canadian gold mines, 2019-2022.

steps.name: Wait for carrier arrival
steps.description: The sealed boxes go back into the vault until the armoured truck arrives on the access road; the crew radios the gate when it is close.

error.defect_description: None introduced; errors from earlier steps pass through.

next.condition: storm or road closure delays the truck

evidence.note: Access is 70 km of secondary gravel road from the highway (wdo2016). Share delayed: Author's estimate from common practice for doré shipments from remote Canadian gold mines, 2019-2022.

steps.name: Reschedule pickup after road delay
steps.description: When snow, freezing rain or a washout stops the truck, the superintendent agrees a new time with the carrier, keeps the boxes in the vault and tells head office and the refinery the new date.

error.defect_description: None introduced; errors from earlier steps pass through.

evidence.note: Winter road conditions on the gravel access road (wdo2016 for the road); frequency is the author's estimate.

steps.name: Check carrier crew at the gate
steps.description: The security officer meets the armoured truck at the gate, checks each crew member's identification and the vehicle number against the carrier's confirmation, logs the entry and escorts the truck to the mill.

error.defect_description: Identification check skipped under time pressure.

control.basis: Site security procedure: verify armoured carrier crew identity against the booking before access to the gold room

evidence.note: Author's estimate from common practice for doré shipments from remote Canadian gold mines, 2019-2022.

steps.name: Hand over boxes and sign custody receipt
steps.description: The superintendent and a gold room operator bring the boxes out under camera, and with the carrier crew count boxes, read every seal number and compare gross weights with the manifest; both sides sign the manifest and the carrier's receipt.

control.basis: Chain of custody for precious metal: signed transfer of sealed boxes to the carrier

evidence.note: Author's estimate from common practice for doré shipments from remote Canadian gold mines, 2019-2022.

steps.name: Send shipment advice
steps.description: The superintendent scans the signed manifest and emails it with the shipment advice to the refinery, the treasury and tax manager and the site controller, and files the originals.

error.defect_description: Advice sent without the signed manifest.

evidence.note: Author's estimate from common practice for doré shipments from remote Canadian gold mines, 2019-2022.

steps.name: Carrier transports doré to the refinery
steps.description: The carrier drives the boxes to its depot, consolidates them with other mines' shipments and moves them by road or air under escort to the refinery, which in 2016 was the Royal Canadian Mint in Ottawa.

error.defect_description: None introduced; errors from earlier steps pass through.

evidence.note: Doré bars shipped to the Royal Canadian Mint in Ottawa for refining (wdo2016); gold refined by external refiners (srk2022). Transit time: Author's estimate from common practice for doré shipments from remote Canadian gold mines, 2019-2022.

steps.name: Compare refinery receipt with the manifest
steps.description: When the refinery emails its receipt with box seal numbers and gross weights, and later its melt weights, the superintendent compares them with the manifest and the mine's bar weights and flags any difference beyond the scale tolerance.

error.defect_description: None introduced; errors from earlier steps pass through.

evidence.note: Settlement uses the receiver's mass measurement, so the shipper checks it (lbmavar2017). Share with mismatch: Author's estimate from common practice for doré shipments from remote Canadian gold mines, 2019-2022.

steps.name: Investigate weight or seal mismatch
steps.description: The superintendent pulls the gold room scale calibration record, the camera footage and the packing sheet, asks the carrier and refinery for their seal photos and weights, and agrees with them which weight stands; a broken seal goes to the carrier's claims process.

error.defect_description: None introduced; errors from earlier steps pass through.

evidence.note: Author's estimate from common practice for doré shipments from remote Canadian gold mines, 2019-2022.

steps.name: Update gold inventory for the shipment
steps.description: The superintendent marks the bars as shipped in the gold room record and the met workbook, so the month's balance shows doré in transit rather than in the vault, and files the refinery receipt.

error.defect_description: Bar marked shipped in the wrong month.

evidence.note: Author's estimate from common practice for doré shipments from remote Canadian gold mines, 2019-2022.

steps.name: Record doré in transit in the ledger
steps.description: The site controller moves the shipment's cost from gold in process at the mill to doré in transit to the refinery in the ERP, using the shipment advice ounces, so the inventory balance is right at month end.

error.defect_description: Wrong ounces or month on the journal.

control.basis: IFRS inventory measurement (IAS 2) and year-end audit of gold in process and doré inventory

evidence.note: Gold in process inventory includes doré awaiting final refining and is carried at cost (wdofs2021). Times: Author's estimate from common practice for doré shipments from remote Canadian gold mines, 2019-2022.

exceptions.name: Shipment split for insurance limit
exceptions.description: A high gold price pushes the declared value over the per-trip limit, so the shipment is replanned as two pickups.

exceptions.name: Pickup delayed by road conditions
exceptions.description: Snow, freezing rain or a washout on the gravel access road stops the armoured truck and the pickup moves by a day or more.

exceptions.name: Weight or seal mismatch at the refinery
exceptions.description: The refinery's receipt weights or seal numbers disagree with the manifest and the shipment is investigated with the carrier and refinery.

benchmarks.unit: calendar days from deciding to ship to confirmed refinery receipt and the in-transit journal
benchmarks.population: Remote Canadian gold mine shipping doré by armoured carrier to a domestic refinery

evidence.note: Booking lead of one to three days, pickup, two days in transit and receipt confirmation; consistent with doré completing refining within a month (wdofs2021). Author's estimate.
Island Gold NSR assumptions table: Au refining and transportation charge 3.25 per oz; payable 99.96%.

pain_points.description: Pickup dates depend on the carrier's northern route and on the gravel access road, so doré can sit in the vault for days beyond the plan.

evidence.note: Access by 70 km of secondary gravel road (wdo2016); carrier scheduling is the author's estimate.

pain_points.description: Every bar is weighed and recorded by hand in several places (gold room record, packing sheet, manifest, advice), so a typing slip shows up only when the refinery receipt arrives.

evidence.note: Author's estimate from common practice for doré shipments from remote Canadian gold mines, 2019-2022.

assumptions: Simulated median cycle time is about 8.2 days against a tier C estimate of 7 days; the difference is the carrier booking wait and the receipt confirmation, both of which vary with the carrier's route.

The refinery is assumed to be a Canadian refiner reached by armoured road and air transport; the 2016 technical report names the Royal Canadian Mint in Ottawa, and the 2022 report says only 'external refiners'.

The organisation file's mill-elution-refining process describes carbon elution and electrowinning; the Eagle River mill uses gravity and Merrill-Crowe zinc precipitation (srk2022). The elution-circuit resource id is used here for the gold room and its vault, which are tied up while bars are handled.
Insurance and carrier-liability checks are done by the treasury and tax manager in Toronto, as the organisation file implies; some mines leave this to the site controller.
Cycle time ends at confirmed refinery receipt; the refinery outturn and sale follow in the gold sales and settlement workflow.
Staffing is tiny (about 0.1 FTE in total) because the process runs only two to four times a month; hands-on time times volume implies less than 0.1 FTE.
Loaded costs come from the organisation file (wage times 1.30 for staff, 1.35 for hourly site roles).
